title: A Morning at the Community Garden
context: Lena 首次参加花园整理活动，向组织者 Sam 了解如何帮忙。本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Is this the community garden workday?
dialogue.zh: 今天是社区花园的劳动日吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: It is. Are you here to help?

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Yes, but I'm new here. Where should I start?
dialogue.zh: 是的，不过我是新来的。我该从哪里开始？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: We're picking up leaves from the paths. Would you like to help?
dialogue.zh: 我们正在清理小路上的落叶。你愿意帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Sure. Where can I find a rake?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: There's one beside the shed. The empty bags are there, too.
dialogue.zh: 棚屋旁边有一把。空袋子也在那里。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Should I put all the leaves in the bags?
dialogue.zh: 我要把所有落叶都装进袋子吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Please leave the pile by the fence. We're saving it for compost.
dialogue.zh: 请留下围栏旁边那堆。我们要留着堆肥。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Got it. I can clear the path near the gate first.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。我可以先清理大门附近的小路。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'll take the other side, and we can meet in the middle.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我清理另一边，我们可以在中间碰头。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: The path is clear now. Where should these bags go?
dialogue.zh: 小路现在清理干净了。这些袋子放哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Next to the shed, please. Thanks for helping out today.
dialogue.zh: 请放在棚屋旁边。谢谢你今天来帮忙。

expressions.zh: 我该从哪里开始？用于询问第一步。
expressions.example: Where should I start with these boxes?
We cleared the path after the storm.

expressions.zh: 在棚屋旁边。beside 表示在旁边。
expressions.example: The wheelbarrow is beside the shed.
Save the paper for your drawing.
My cousin helped out at the event.

pronunciation: community 重音在第二音节；path 结尾的 th 用舌尖轻触上齿送气。

practice.title: Part 1 · Gardens
practice.prompt: Do you enjoy spending time in gardens?
practice.answer: Yes. I like quiet gardens because I can walk slowly and notice the plants. I sometimes visit one near my home after work.

practice.title: Part 2 · Working together
practice.prompt: Describe a time you helped with a shared space. Say where it was, what you did, and how you felt.
practice.answer: Last fall I helped clean a small garden near my apartment. A neighbor invited me to join a group on Saturday morning. We picked up leaves and put them in bags, and another person swept the path. I had never met some of the helpers before, so we introduced ourselves while we worked. When we finished, the path looked much tidier. I felt useful and enjoyed meeting people nearby. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Shared spaces
practice.prompt: Why do shared spaces need people to work together?
practice.answer: One person may not have enough time to care for a shared space. When people divide the work, the job becomes easier, and they can discuss what the space needs.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后扮演新志愿者，询问从哪里开始、工具在哪里，并确认落叶如何处理。
practice.answer: Where should I start? Is there a rake I can use? Should I put these leaves in a bag?
